Queen's Sudan Medal 1896-7 Medal awarded to 3435 H Eley, 1st Battalion, Lincolnshire Regiment circular silver medal; with ribbon obverse- Half length figure of Queen Victoria wearing a small crown and veil, holding a sceptre in her right hand, with the legend ‘VICTORIA REGINA ET IMPERATRIX’. reverse- A figure of Victory, who is seated, holding a palm branch in her right hand and laurel wreath in her left; at her feet is the word ‘SUDAN’ on a plaque supported by three lilies; behind her and on either side are the British and Egyptian flags. ribbon- 32mm wide; half yellow, half black with a thin dividing red stripe named on edge- 3435 H.ELEY 1-LINCOLN REGT.
artist: George William de Saulles
